body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Robot cleaner manufacturing specialty company Mami Robot(representative Jang Seung-rak, www.mamirobot.co.kr) released new robot cleaner 'Mami Robot Sevian'.
Robot cleaner Mami Robot Sevian sold 2,147 cleaners for last one month, though they didn't offer any discount.

On the other hand, Mami Robot have made contract with over 30 companies from France, UK and Argentina etc. at CES 2011 held in Las Vegas from last 6-9 and so it's expected to make additional profits of 120,000 cleaners(25 million USD) a year from second half of this year.

This is almost close to its exportation plan as of 150,000 cleaner sales for this year. Because it established independent corporations in USA, Japan and Germany 1 year before, this opportunity will be the important foothold to increase market share at global market.
The industry circle estimates the size of world market of robot cleaner as 2.5 million scale and domestic market is expected to be enlarged from 200,000 to 400,000.
